haiku.problem: "This proverb" points to a lesson the baker may not have seen. Asked at random, the question has no referent. It should name the speaker or describe the saying in plain words, for example "In Proverbs, what does the advice say to do instead of taking revenge?"

"According to this proverb" has the same issue. Asked at random, nothing identifies which proverb is meant. It should name the source or describe it, for example "According to Proverbs, what preserves a king and keeps his throne?"
